Hi team — quick finance checklist so we all have the same expectations:

1) For WA we require a clear, signed resale certificate that includes: seller name, buyer name (Green Widgets Inc.), the buyer's UBI/tax registration number, effective date, and a statement of purchaser's intent to resell the goods.
2) If the invoice contains both taxable subscription services and exempt resale items, the certificate only covers exempt lines. Please provide a line-item breakdown or confirm the classification so we can apply exemption correctly.
3) Once a corrected cert is received we run automated validation (same-day if submitted before 3pm PST). If the cert validates, we can clear the hold and process the payment in our next AP run (typically T+2 business days after clearance).

For a partial payment release: finance will consider releasing up to 50% of the invoice if the cert is substantively correct but missing a non-material field (e.g., missing signature page but UBI/effective date present). However, we need an RMB (reason & mitigating backup) note from procurement explaining the risk acceptance.

Tim — if you can attach the updated certificate with the UBI printed (not handwritten) and a signed effective date, please send it here and we'll prioritize validation.

Thanks,
